03What It IsOVERVIEW▶

A Claude skill that collects the complete comment tree of a Facebook post, in a group, on a page, or on a profile. It switches the post to All comments, expands every hidden reply, records who answered whom, and saves the result as one JSON file.

After delivering the file, Claude offers a button to build Swami's vibe dashboard from it: the post, discussion stats and participants, Claude's themes and takeaways, every thread, a search, a mind map, a glossary, and an audio overview.

Why it mattersFacebook lazy-loads comments, hides replies behind "View all N replies", and defaults to "Most relevant", which leaves some comments out. Group posts also need a signed-in member, so a plain web fetch or Claude's cloud workspace gets nothing.
04What It DoesOVERVIEW▶
  • All commentsSwitches the post's sort from "Most relevant" to All comments, so filtered and spam-flagged comments show too.
  • Expand allClicks every "View more comments", "View all N replies", and "See more" until nothing is left. It only clicks expanders, never Like, Reply, or Send.
  • Count checkCompares the comments found with the count Facebook shows under the post, and reports any gap.
  • Reply-to linksWorks out exactly which comment or reply each reply answers, even deep in a thread.
  • Threaded JSONWrites fb_<group-or-page>_<postid>_comments.json with the post details, counts, a nested thread tree, and a flat list of the same items.
  • PermalinksGives every comment a clean link with tracking stripped. Links to group posts open for group members.
  • Approximate datesTurns Facebook's relative ages (4d, 2w, 1y) into approximate dates; exact times only on request.
  • DashboardOn request, or from the button after delivery, builds a vibe dashboard in the current vibe-dashboard format: the post, stats and participants, themes and open requests, every thread (with an OP tag on the post author's own comments), Search, Mind Map, Glossary, references, and an audio overview.

08Capabilities and LimitationsSCOPE▶
  • Every replyGets every comment and reply, including the ones hidden behind "Most relevant" and collapsed reply links.
  • Exact threadingRecords the exact comment or reply each reply answers, not just its thread.
  • Groups tooWorks on group, page, and profile posts, as long as Swami can see the post while signed in.
  • Read-onlyNever likes, reacts, replies, comments, joins groups, or accepts prompts on Swami's behalf.
  • Reusable JSONA dashboard can be built later from a JSON this skill made, with no new extraction.
  • FallbackIf the pane won't work, a saved copy of the page can be uploaded and parsed instead.
  • Needs sign-inSwami must be signed in to Facebook in the browser, and a member of the group for group posts. Claude never types his password.
  • Needs a browserExtraction needs the desktop app's pane or real Chrome with Claude in Chrome; a web fetch or the cloud workspace gets nothing.
  • Approximate datesDates come from relative ages like 4d or 2w, so they're approximate unless exact times are asked for.
  • Member-only linksPermalinks to group posts open only for group members.
  • Count gapsThe total can differ a little from Facebook's shown count; Claude reports the gap.
  • Page changesIt reads Facebook's page layout, which Facebook can change without notice.
  • Windows untestedThe Windows desktop app and Chrome on Windows have not been tried yet.
09Scheduled TasksRUNTIME▶

None. The skill runs only when asked and neither needs nor creates a scheduled task. The nightly "Skills dashboard nightly refresh" repackages its zip for GitHub but never runs it.

11GotchasGOTCHAS▶
  • Wrong windowclaude.ai open in Comet looks just like the desktop app. The tell is the browser's tab strip and address bar; there's no browser pane there, and Cmd+Shift+B only toggles Comet's bookmarks bar.
  • Hidden app windowThe desktop app can be running with no window open. Make Claude active and use Window → Show Main Window (or Cmd+N, or quit and relaunch).
  • Opening the paneIn the app window, click the globe icon at the top right (left of Share), or press Cmd+Shift+B.
  • Not signed in"Log In" or "Join group" on the page means Claude stops and asks you to sign in yourself.
  • Most relevantFacebook's default sort hides some comments; the skill always switches to All comments first.
  • Long outputBig threads are read from the page in chunks so nothing gets cut off.
  • Tagged namesFacebook starts many replies with the tagged person's name; the text is kept as it is.
  • Saved-page fallbackIf the pane won't cooperate, expand everything in your own browser, save the page as Web Page, Complete (Ctrl+S on Windows), and upload the .html.
  • Hidden offerThe dashboard offer comes as a button, sent last, because a file card can push a text offer out of view.
  • Project threadsWhere the file, message, or button tools aren't available, Claude attaches the file that surface's own way and sends the summary and the dashboard offer as plain messages.
  • Crushed columnsDashboard thread tables use exactly three columns (From, Comment, Link); more columns make names break one letter per line.
  • Personal detailsEmails or phone numbers in comments are kept as written. Claude mentions them and asks before putting them on a dashboard meant for public sharing.
12Other RequirementsREFERENCE▶
  • A computerA Mac, or a Windows 10 or 11 PC, with the Claude desktop app or Google Chrome with the Claude in Chrome extension.
  • Facebook accountSigned in to Facebook in that browser, and a member of the group for group posts.
  • Code executionClaude's code execution ("Create and edit files") must be on to build the JSON and the dashboard.
  • Site accessThe browser pane must be allowed to open facebook.com; Claude asks for it the first time.
  • DashboardsThe vibe-dashboard skill must be installed to build a comments dashboard.

In the Appears in column, each number is a jump link to where that term is used in that section (hover to preview the line); the term flashes green when you arrive. TermTopicDefinitionAppears inQty
Facebook groupFacebookA Facebook community whose posts only signed-in members can see; the skill needs Swami to be a member.
PostFacebookThe Facebook item whose comments the skill collects, in a group, on a page, or on a profile.
All commentsFacebookFacebook's comment sort that shows every comment, including filtered ones; the skill always switches to it.
Most relevantFacebookFacebook's default comment sort, which hides some comments.
ExpanderFacebookA link like "View all 4 replies" or "See more" that reveals hidden comments or text; the skill clicks them all.
OPFacebookThe original poster, the person who made the post; marked with an OP tag in dashboard threads.

ThreadStructureA top-level comment and every reply under it.
Reply-to linkStructureWhich exact comment or reply a reply answers, stored as parent_id.
Threaded JSONStructureThe main output: the post details, counts, a nested thread tree, and a flat list of the same items.
Flat listStructureEvery comment and reply as one row with its reply count, best for dashboards.
PermalinkLinksA clean link to one comment, using Facebook's comment_id (and reply_comment_id for replies), with tracking removed.
Approximate dateLinksA date worked out from Facebook's relative age (4d, 2w, 1y) and the day of the pull.
Count gapLinksThe difference between the comments found and the count Facebook shows under the post.
Vibe dashboardDeliverySwami's dark-theme single-page dashboard design; this skill can build one from the comments JSON.
Dashboard buttonDeliveryThe clickable "Build a vibe-dashboard?" offer Claude sends as the last thing after delivering the JSON.
